contentText: Israeli tanks advanced in an area of the central Gaza Strip on Wednesday, witnesses said, and the Israeli military said its ​forces were targeting ‌Hamas infrastructure outside the "Yellow Line" that sets the boundary of the part of the enclave controlled by Israel "The IDF launched a precise operation within the Gaza Strip earlier today west of the Yellow Line... to remove a threat posed to IDF troops operating in the Gaza Strip," the military said.
